## Behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] New work is on a separate descriptive branch.
- [ ] Hand-authored files are at most 300 lines; data stays in typed lists.
- [ ] New direct packages are documented in `docs/PACKAGES.md`.
- [ ] Feature and version Markdown notes with Mermaid diagrams exist in `docs/`;
      changelog and UI patterns are updated where relevant.
- [ ] Regression coverage exercises changed behavior and failure cases.
- [ ] Policy check, formatter, analyzer, tests and web build pass.
- [ ] Arabic/English, narrow layout and increased text size checked.
- [ ] Runtime screenshots reviewed; limitations clearly stated.

## Limitations

List unverified devices or integrations and any required follow-up.
